answer: Each identity runs one barometer on its island and locks an 80-credit bond. At solar zenith it emits a pressure pulse with its serial and reading. An auditor rechecks it against the public altitude-pressure table; deviation over 2%, reused serial, or missed filing burns the bond. First 46 credits; the k-th 46+7(k-1), each extra one needing its own island site and survey, so the 1000th is 7,039 and 1,000 fakes cost 3,542,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-barometer ring fails: one serial fits only its own island altitude. An honest agent pays 46 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
